वीटा

VĪṬĀ . A ball made of wood. The kaurava boys played with this ball and by accident the vīṭā fell in a well. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 130, Stanza 17, that the teacher droṇa recovered it from the well by shooting a number of arrows, one upon the tail of another.

विटभूत

VIṬABHŪTA . An asura. Mention is made in mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 65, that this asura stays in the palace of varuṇa praising and worshipping him.
